public.moderation.title: Moderation notices
public.moderation.intro: When we take something of yours off a public page, or correct it, the statement of reasons is here. Each one stays here for as long as you have your account.
public.moderation.unavailable: We couldn't load your moderation notices just now. Please try again.
public.moderation.kind.DEBATE_HIDDEN: Your debate is off the public page while we review it
public.moderation.kind.DEBATE_DECIDED: Your debate stays off the public page
public.moderation.kind.CONTRIBUTION_REMO: We removed your contribution from a public debate
public.moderation.kind.REPORT_REMOVED: We removed your report from a public debate
public.moderation.kind.CORRECTED: We corrected your text in a public debate
public.moderation.kind.CONTRIBUTION_AFFE: Your contribution is off a public page during a review
public.moderation.kind.REPORT_AFFECTED: Your report is off a public page during a review
public.moderation.what.DEBATE_HIDDEN: We took your public debate off the public page while we review it. Nobody can read it there, in any country, until a person decides; there is no set end date. Your account and your other debates are not affected.
public.moderation.what.DEBATE_DECIDED: We decided that your public debate stays off the public page. Nobody can read it there, in any country, and there is no end date. It stays in your account, and your other debates are not affected.
public.moderation.what.CONTRIBUTION_REMO: We removed a contribution you made from the public page of this debate, in every country and with no end date. It stays in your account, as your own.
public.moderation.what.REPORT_REMOVED: We removed a report you asked for from the public page of this debate, in every country and with no end date.
public.moderation.what.CORRECTED: This debate came back on the public page with corrections to your text. We replaced the parts that broke our rules, in every country and with no end date, and kept the rest.
public.moderation.what.CONTRIBUTION_AFFE: A contribution you made left the public page of this debate together with other content we are reviewing. Your own contribution was not found to break any rule. It stays in your account, and it is off the page until a person puts it back or the review ends.
public.moderation.what.REPORT_AFFECTED: A report you asked for left the public page of this debate together with other content we are reviewing. Your own report was not found to break any rule. It is off the page until a person puts it back or the review ends.
public.moderation.nowHidden: The debate is still off the public page.
public.moderation.nowPublic: The debate is on the public page again.
public.moderation.source.REPORT_BUTTON: This started from a report someone made with the Report button. We do not tell you who made it.
public.moderation.source.EMAIL_NOTICE: This started from a report someone sent us by email. We do not tell you who sent it.
public.moderation.source.AUTHORITY_ORDER: This started from an order of a public authority.
public.moderation.source.OWN_INITIATIVE: We acted on our own initiative: nobody reported it to us.
public.moderation.automatedDecision: An automatic check read the report and took this step by itself, with no person involved yet. A person will review it.
public.moderation.automatedDetection: An AI read the report first. A person made this decision.
public.moderation.noAutomation: A person made this decision, without automated means.
public.moderation.groundNone: No rule was recorded for this step, because it was taken before we kept one. Write to office@dezbatere.ro and a person will tell you.
public.moderation.ground.REVIEW_HOLD: Our Terms of Service, section 9: we can hide a public debate while we review it.
public.moderation.ground.UNLAWFUL: Our Terms of Service, section 7: do not submit or publish unlawful content.
public.moderation.ground.HATE_SPEECH: Our Terms of Service, section 7: no hate speech of any kind.
public.moderation.ground.WEAPONS_OR_DRUG: Our Terms of Service, section 7: no instructions for crafting weapons or drugs.
public.moderation.ground.SUICIDE_OR_HARM: Our Terms of Service, section 7: no content encouraging suicide or harming other people.
public.moderation.ground.RELIGIOUS_INSUL: Our Terms of Service, section 7: no religious insult.
public.moderation.ground.PERSONAL_DATA: Our Terms of Service, section 7: do not submit personal data about other people.
public.moderation.ground.ILLEGAL: The law: the content is illegal. The facts below name the law.
public.moderation.suspectedIntro: What the review is about, not yet decided:
public.moderation.factsDeleted: The facts were deleted twelve months after the step. The rule and the dates stay.
public.moderation.quoteIntro: The words of the page the automatic check found:
public.moderation.routes: To challenge this decision, reply to our email or write to office@dezbatere.ro within six months: a person who was not involved will review it. You can also take it to a certified out-of-court dispute settlement body, or to court.
